ca_culture_thunderlander_1_desc;The feared Thunderlander Raiders are a terror in the battlefield
column2: as their brutal attacks leave armies in awe and fear.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_plainslander_1_desc;Trained from the fields and farms they were raised on and protect
column2: the cavalrymen of the Plains fight with speed and shock.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_somali_1_desc;The Soomali High Guards are a renowned and mighty force employed by their lieges. Their high offense gives them a seemingly unfair advantage towards their adversaries.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
ca_culture_ozarkian_1_desc;The Ozarkian Lancers are horsemen who charge in the battlefield
column2: defending their homeland in pride. Their lances pierce any armor their foes don on their body.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_arkensawyer_1_desc;The Arkensawyer Militia are able men who posses great zeal to their service in order to attack and defend with great will. Armed with swords and pikes
column2: they fight with fanatic morale.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_californio_group_1_desc;The Californio Frontiersmen are conscripts or sometimes hired arms that look over the borderlands of the realms. Warriors first and law enforcers second
column2: they ride throughout with no worry unless about pay.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_tejano_1_desc;The Vaqueros of the Tejano differ from their kin: they wield guns instead of bows
column2: thanks to the abundance of such in the Lone Star State. Alongside the usual shock cavalry
column3: the extra firepower mows through the enemy.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_regio_1_desc;The Regio have more centralized settlements than their Nortenyo kin
column2: but could not simply abandon the Vaquero tradition. The solution? Give them heavy weapons! The Lanceros are transformed Vaqueros with heavy armor and heavier weapons
column3: rampaging through battlefields.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_north_mexican_1_desc;The Nortenyo frontier is seen as harsh and unforgiving
column2: and the Vaqueros do not help that reputation. The Vaqueros are quick cavalrymen who strike terror and fear to any poor person who has the misfortune of facing them.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_chilangos_1_desc;The Guardia Imperial are the grandest of Mexico's men-at-arms. Protecting the heart of the Empire
column2: their task is backed with their armor and weaponry.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_norteabajeno_1_desc;The Abajenyo Troopers are men who are well suited to wander the plains like their homeland's. Roaming the battlefield
column2: they pick out and pin down enemies.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_fronterizo_1_desc;The Fronterizos only have one job: protect most of the Empire from the northern threat. The Fronterizo Guardsmen are the pinnacle of that thinking
column2: with their pikes and swords slashing through the battle.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_ocaseno_1_desc;The terrain of the Tapatio homeland is ruthless and full with dangers. Due to this
column2: their special infantry is suited and armed with their best equipment to deal with whatever ails their community.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_sudabajeno_1_desc;The Calentano Militia are a flexible unit suited to the challenges that they face travelling through their land.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

ca_culture_ribereno_1_desc;The Jarocho Skirmishers are a unit made due to the vast farmlands that their people occupy. Their fast action towards threats gives their people a defense against their adversaries.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
ca_culture_oaxaqueno_1_desc;The Fraylescano Infantry are combatants who sweep out any danger that comes out of the jungles they find themselves inhabiting.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

ca_culture_yucatanense_1_desc;The Yucatanense field the finest crossbows their side of the Yucatan can offer. A powerful punch paired with piercing through armor gives them their reputation.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
ca_culture_hmong_1_desc;The Hmong Highlanders are men who dwell in the mountains
column2: showcasing excellent defence against any foe.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_amero_japonic_1_desc;As the Event ravaged upon the lands
column2: the Japanese in the American continent molded back a tradition back home: bodyguards who serve the realm and their families. The Ronin are highly sought after
column3: with their fiece power from their swords attracting men from different realms.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_pinoy_1_desc;A martial arts tradition hailing from the homeland
column2: the Arnis Infantry are men armed with hardwood sticks to inflict maiming damage towards the enemy.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: ca_culture_coptifornian_1_desc;The Niremenkhemi Spearmen are revered spearmen who use their long spears to crash any enemy advance.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
